title: Let fresh Naam settle inside
summary: Naam enters the mind as an ever-fresh inward renewal. Return the mind to better company before it scatters again.
takeaway: Return the mind to better company before it scatters again.
lifeApplication: When you feel stale and start reaching for stimulation, stay still one breath longer. Invite the Name inward before you go hunting for refreshment outside.

source.shortMeaning: Naam enters the mind as an ever-fresh inward renewal.
source.lifeApplication: When restlessness reaches outward, let the Name arrive inward first.

evidence.coreClaim: Naam enters the mind as an ever-fresh inward renewal.
evidence.turn: Carry this with you: stay still long enough for fresh Naam to settle.
evidence.practicalImplication: When you feel stale and start reaching for stimulation, stay still one breath longer. Invite the Name inward before you go hunting for refreshment outside.
